description: Would this request fit in the remaining quota, given a snapshot and pending reservations? (snapshot-bound) — Computes available quota from a caller-supplied snapshot (limit, used, reserved) minus the unexpired pending reservations and says whether a requested amount fits. This is a read of the numbers you supply as of snapshotAt: it reserves nothing, so concurrent consumers can still use the quota before you do, and every response says so. A stale snapshot gives unknown, not pass; a window that ended at

asOf.description: RFC 3339 instant of the decision (no clock is read).

expiresAt.description: RFC 3339; a reservation expiring at or before asOf no longer holds quota. Omit for a hold that does not expire.

reserved.description: Amount already reserved and counted outside `pending`.

windowEndsAt.description: RFC 3339 end of the quota window the snapshot belongs to.

snapshotAt.description: RFC 3339 instant the quota numbers were read.

name: quota-reservation-check
